canonical_traits: 青丘之山所见之兽，整体形态如狐
食其肉可使人不受蛊毒侵害
visual_inferences: 采用后世《瑞应编》转引的赤色记载作为铜红主毛色，而非冒充《山海经》原文
胸腹、吻部与尾尖使用低饱和象牙白，增强九尾分界与近景辨识度
整体保持自然狐科解剖比例，以青丘山地捕食者而非人形狐妖呈现
九尾从骶尾区分束生长并作扇形错相展开，确保每条尾根和完整尾长可读

locked_traits: exactly nine complete tails with nine distinct roots and tips
all tails continuously attached to the sacral and caudal body region
long pointed fox muzzle and two upright triangular ears

counted_features.evidence_rule: one uninterrupted fox head and muzzle
paired eyes on one fox head
one grounded paw at the end of every leg
nine independently traceable tail roots, bodies and tips with visible negative space

continuous_features.rule: muzzle, skull, neck, thorax, abdomen, pelvis and spine form one plausible continuous quadruped volume
each tail is a full-volume tapering structure continuously connected from the sacral tail fan to one tip; no fusion, branching or floating segments
each shoulder or hip connects continuously through anatomically placed joints to a paw

articulated_regions.motion: head turn, pitch, jaw opening and recovery
articulated_regions.attachment: cervical chain into skull and mandibular hinge
paired pivots at the upper skull

articulated_regions.motion: quadruped gait flexion, compression, extension and turn
walk, run, crouch, push-off, landing and weight transfer
articulated_regions.attachment: paired shoulder and hip chains with elbow/stifle, carpal/hock and paw articulation

articulated_regions.motion: independent root fan, overlapping body waves and tip follow-through with phase offsets
articulated_regions.attachment: nine separately readable roots distributed across one intact sacral/caudal fan

articulated_regions.motion: infant-like call, snarl and breathing shape
articulated_regions.attachment: muzzle, jaw, cheeks and throat remain connected

surface_features.rule: medium-scale sculpted clumps follow anatomical flow and break the silhouette along cheeks, neck ruff, belly, elbows, haunches and tails
normal and roughness retain directional variation at normal camera distance and 200 percent close-up
eyes, wet nose, lips, teeth and whisker pads remain materially distinct from fur
claws and teeth show harder, smoother reflectance than fur without plastic shine

creative_brief.identity: 《山海经》青丘山地的九尾捕食者：真实狐科骨架、非人形、一首四足九尾
creative_brief.material_language: layered sculpted fox fur with directional PBR breakup; wet dark nose, amber eyes and restrained keratin claws
creative_brief.pose_lock: neutral alert quadruped stance, all four paws grounded, spine level, head forward, nine tails fanned backward and upward with distinct root-to-tip negative spaces

scene.terrain: 低矮青草、浅色岩砾与远处层叠丘陵
scene.weather: 薄雾但主体活动区清晰

lighting.key: soft warm dawn from upper right
lighting.contrast: restrained to preserve copper fur and ivory tail tips
